page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7se.2xlarge is an x86_64 memory-optimized virtual machine instance deployed on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by a dedicated 2.9 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor configured with 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs via multithreading. It features 48 KB L1 data cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and a shared 48 MB L3 cache, with instruction set support including AVX-512 and VNNI for vectorized workloads. Memory provisioning is prominent, providing 64.0 GB of system RAM, yielding a high 8:1 memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

Hardware accelerators are absent, with zero GPUs provisioned. Local storage is also not bundled, requiring remote block storage for persistent file systems. Baseline network throughput is configured at 3 Gbps. Benchmarks reflect steady mid-tier general performance, scoring 11,411.96 on PassMark CPU and 5,941.0 on Geekbench multi-core. Memory bandwidth tests yield uncached read speeds of 60.9 GB/sec and write speeds of 43.15 GB/sec, supporting in-memory processing demands.

Application testing demonstrates capability for caching and database systems, achieving 8.03 million Redis SET operations per second and 4,136.83 on PassMark database tests. Conversely, CPU-driven machine learning highlights clear limitations: while lightweight 135M parameter language models process efficiently, 7B model generation drops to 7.51 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU hardware. With high memory allocation per core, this instance offers balanced resource efficiency for in-memory caching, relational databases, analytics tasks, and memory-intensive enterprise services.
